subject: Gut health is an ecology, not a single supplement
script: From Agewell Brief: Gut health is an ecology, not a single supplement. The Inner Garden guide treats the gut as a living ecology. Its focus is not a quick reset, but the conditions that help a person build steadier routines around food, digestion, and microbial balance. Digestive symptoms are often discussed as if they have one cause. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
